detail.longDescription: From a NetBSD VM with CTWM to a # FreeBSD VPS! 🐡 What started a few weeks ago as a quick # RunBSD test has evolved into a private self-hosting project. Even though it's "just" a VPS running on QEMU/KVM under the hood, # FreeBSD has been rock solid. Current stack: 🧅 Snowflake proxy 🧬 BOINC 🎬 Private federated PeerTube 💬 Private Matrix homeserver 🌐 Web + .onion + Gemini capsule Check out the project: https:// freedom-node-42.eu # SelfHosted # Tor # Privacy
